description: Answer website visitors from the business profile, save their contact requests as leads, hand the chat to staff, and offer reply buttons.
migration_note: Compiled Rust adapter storing the profile and leads in the agent plane. Profile edits and lead review are staff-only (owner or member) in addition to capability-ladder grants. request_human reuses the shared-chat help request and requires the agent's help policy. Deployment requires rebuilding both API and loop.
skill_summary: Business profile answers, visitor lead capture, staff handoff and reply-button choices.
